learning_outcomes.text: Students know the basic concepts of vector analysis and numerical mathematics.
Students are able to analyze and solve simple technical problems from mechanical engineering using methods of vector analysis and numerical mathematics, also through the use of appropriate software.
Students can implement simple algorithms in a high-level programming language on a computer.

syllabus_topics: Vector analysis: Derivative of a vector
Integral theorems of Gauss and Stokes
Solving linear systems of equations with iterative methods
Solving ordinary and partial differential equations
Implementation of algorithms in a high-level programming language such as C, C++, Java or MATLAB
assessment_rules: The prerequisite for receiving credit points is passing the module examination. The importance of the grade for the final grade is in accordance with the study and examination regulations (SPO).
